howTo.title: How it works
howTo.item1: A quote is created from an order: open the order, tab Documents, Create new document and choose the type “Quote”.
howTo.item2: The “Valid until” date on the quote is the document date plus Quote validity in days. The value can be set differently per sales channel.
howTo.item3: Quotes have their own number range “Quotes” under Settings > General > Number ranges.
howTo.item4: Title, headline and the “Valid until” line are snippets and can be adjusted under Settings > Localisation > Snippets (search for “act_quote”).
howTo.item5: Logo, sender and footer come from the document template of type “Quote” (name “quote”) under Settings > Commerce > Documents.

info.description: Adds a new document type “Quote” with its own number range and PDF template. Allows the creation of quote documents directly from existing orders in the admin.
